description: Binds an atproto account to the Ed25519 key that signs its Freehold authorization records. The account holder publishes it in their own repository; a verifier reads it to check records whose root DID is this account. Deleting or replacing it revokes the binding for records issued from then on; a verifier that allows historical keys may still accept records dated inside an earlier binding's window.

main.description: The account's current Freehold signing key. One per repository.

publicKeyMultibase.description: The Ed25519 public key as a did:key would carry it: multicodec 0xed01, base58btc, multibase prefix z.

createdAt.description: When the key was bound. Records issued before this do not verify against it.

expiresAt.description: When the binding stops being usable for new records. Absent for no expiry.
